description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DecoratorTrait' within the 'OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator' namespace. The trait provides methods for managing a decorator object, including lazy initialization and generating decorator class names based on the class it is mixed into.

methods.name: getDecorator
methods.description: Returns the decorator object, initializing it if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: getDecoratorClassName
methods.description: Generates the full class name of the decorator based on the current class name.
